notes.title: Cobalt Core!!!
notes.content:
Hello again, builders!

[h1]Our new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179850/Cobalt_Core/][b]Cobalt Core[/b][/url], is out!!![/h1]

If you liked Sunshine Heavy Industries' characters, music, aesthetic, or [i]general vibe[/i], we think Cobalt Core will be right up your alley. Plus, a few SHI characters may make a return appearance.  :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39869346/8d267e15fd096a45adbdae23f004196fb1e123c0.png[/img]

[i](Yes, this announcement IS a little late- the game came out a few weeks ago. We've been very busy post-launch! Forgive us!!!)[/i]

notes.title: 1.3.1 hotfix
notes.content: v1.3.1 is a quick hotfix- only 2 of the 5 changes to the daily actually went live last update.  (Whoops!)  The rest are now live as well!

notes.title: Anniversary Edition! 1.3.0! And our biggest sale ever!
notes.content:
Hello, builders!  It's been ONE WHOLE YEAR since the launch of version 1.0, so we're celebrating with an update and our biggest sale ever- 40% off all week, starting 9 AM PST!

[list]
[*] Added anniversary party mission!
[*] Added part: Scaffold 5x5
[*] Added part: Cone 3x2
[*] Hyper Pump cost 700k -> 660k
[*] Added new level requirement: "Import Taxes", which adds a flat 50k fee per part used
[*] Post-game missions have a better variety of background visuals
[*] Post-game missions have more requirements based on the client; for example, the lava guy requires extreme heat sinks
[*] Daily changes:
[*] Lowered chance of cloaked missions from 20% to 15%
[*] Added 3% chance of Extreme Heat requirement
[*] Added 5% chance of Import Taxes requirement
[*] Added 7% chance of Tractor Beam requirement
[*] Added 10% chance of Crew Connected requirement
[*] A few small bugfixes
[*] Fixed a single missing sprite that, somehow, nobody ever noticed
[/list]

# 1.2.2

- Removed planets from gif export
- Fixed main menu ships being offscreen sometimes
- Fixed Wren's missing snoot in one sprite

notes.title: Spooky version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!  Dracula is already a character in the game, so we can't get much spookier than that, but we tried anyway with a silly pumpkin mission.

[list]
[*] Achievements!
[*] Halloween mission!
[*] Tons of new background art! Planets! Space!
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Reduced texture memory usage
[*] Fixed Hyper Pump hover visual bug
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
Visibility improvements and bug fixes!

# 1.1.1

- Added settings menu option to enable dailies without finishing story
- Fixed tractor beam edge case

# 1.1.2

- Made some level backgrounds darker
- Unfinished ships no longer pass in the background
- Made warnings blink slower and fade in/out
- Made part hover overlays more opaque

notes.title: Version 1.1: Tractor Beams and Trash Engines
notes.content:
Our first content patch after full launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39869346/4cb15cea2fe2284725e057f1af779a72b620b3f4.gif[/img]

[b]# 1.1.0[/b]

- 6 new parts:
- Panel Concave 2x2
- Panel Concave 4x4
- Panel Corner 2x2
- Incinerator 8x5
- Golden Engine 4x2
- Tractor Beam

- Hovering over "Loose Parts" requirement now highlights separated ship sections
- Parts with fractional prices per cell for more control over balance
- 2 New missions!

- Balance changes:
- Hyperpump cost 800k -> 700k
- Tank Hull 4x1 cost 160k -> 140k
- Solar Panel cost 450k -> 375k
- Solar Panel power radius decreased 4 -> 3
- Solar Panel power supply increased 15 -> 18
- Lead Bunk 4x2 cost 400k -> 320k
- Cloak 3x3 energy requirement 360 -> 270
- Hull Round 2x2 cost 21k -> 20k
- Hull Round 4x4 cost 49k -> 50k

- Added new "rat emotion"
- Various other tweaks and improvements

notes.title: Small patches- 0.9.2 through 0.9.13
notes.content:
Hello, builders!  This last week since launch, we've been focused on bugfixes and some visual tweaks based on player feedback.  [url=https://discord.gg/qeFqyc4W45]We've been posting regular patchnotes on the Discord[/url], if you'd like slightly more up-to-date updates.

Now that the dust is settling from launch, our next focuses are a small content update and a public-facing roadmap for upcoming features.  Keep an eye out!

# 2021/5/11

# 0.9.1

- Early access launch!

# 0.9.2

- Fixed pixel perfect rendering on scaled displays
- Render nebula on extremely wide aspect ratios
- Fixed selection bug

# 0.9.3

- Fixed some typos
- Reduced exported gif filesize

# 0.9.4

- Fixed icons
- Fixed part costs
- Fixed cursor pixel

# 2021/5/12

# 0.9.5

- Alphabetized parts and folders
- Renamed long part name
- Ships with irradiated parts can no longer pass

# 0.9.6

- Reworked reactor, lab, and ftl sprites

# 2021/5/13

- Gif export tweaks

- Fixed typos
